a77742b1-befd-49a4-bff5-1ad4e6b0ef7b.title: Chainsaw Man
a77742b1-befd-49a4-bff5-1ad4e6b0ef7b.description:
Broke young man + chainsaw dog demon = Chainsaw Man!  
  
The name says it all! Denji's life of poverty is changed forever when he merges with his pet chainsaw dog, Pochita! Now he's living in the big city and an official Devil Hunter. But he's got a lot to learn about his new job and chainsaw powers!

chapters.title: Chu Chu Lovely Muni Muni Mura Mura

296cbc31-af1a-4b5b-a34b-fee2b4cad542.title: 【Oshi no Ko】
296cbc31-af1a-4b5b-a34b-fee2b4cad542.description:
The story begins with a beautiful girl, her perfectly fake smile, and the people who love her selfishly for it.  
  
What transpires behind the scenes of the glittering showbiz industry? How far would you go for the sake of your beloved idol? What would you do if you found out reincarnation was real? The star of the show is Aquamarine Hoshino and the stage is but a mere facade. Will he manage to reach the climax before the world of glamour swallows him whole?

901da7d9-8742-4f1a-9432-b7c1e67a5daf.title: Ryuu to Ayumu Nariagari Boukensha-dou ~Youzumi toshite S-Rank Party kara Tsuihou Sareta Kaifuku Majutsushi, Suterareta Saki de Saikyou no Shinryuu wo Fukkatsu Saseteshimau~
901da7d9-8742-4f1a-9432-b7c1e67a5daf.altTitle: Take the Same Path as Dragon
901da7d9-8742-4f1a-9432-b7c1e67a5daf.description:
"Understand for yourself that you are worthless. You are already obsolete."

Dion, the recovery wizard who was told so, was seriously injured by the hands of party members and left behind in the interior of the highest difficulty dungeon. On the verge of running out of his life, he happens to encounter a dying dragon. Dion realized that he couldn't help him anymore, and he treated the dragon to live as a recovery wizard until the end. Then the dragon thanked him and even shared the power of the dragon. In addition, this dragon seems to have been a legendary god dragon-class. Dion escapes from the dungeon with his new companion, the dragon, and restarts as an adventurer. He captures the difficult dungeons that stand in his way, and his abilities are recognized and he has all the strong men on his side.
___
**Character Designer:** [Sisoe](https://mangadex.org/author/9a1a04cb-1d27-4601-809d-665b4f4918c4)

3c8f55a0-ce7e-4ee3-8880-c54e6796fdf9.title: Tokusatsu Gagaga
3c8f55a0-ce7e-4ee3-8880-c54e6796fdf9.description: Nakamura Kano is an OL (office lady) with a secret… she’s a “Toku Otaku,” a tokusatsu otaku who is obsessed with live action dramas of heroes, monsters and robots. She thinks they’re “JUST TOO COOL!” She’s so obsessed that she skips out on drinking with colleagues to watch it on TV and collects the DVDs, books and figurines. She lives her life by the code of the tokusatsu heroes, and constantly imagines them to help her through difficult situations. But this isn’t easy when all of her co-workers think that people who like anime and other childish things are weird, and they keep trying to make her socialize.

chapters.title: What Do You Do With Your Collection?
Take Off From the Secret Base!
The Tears I Wipe Off Fill My Courage Tank!
Even if You Say Not to Worry...

b7ebc129-8729-4121-9f11-c3260d3d97ed.title: Sun-ouji wa Tsuma ni Naritai
b7ebc129-8729-4121-9f11-c3260d3d97ed.altTitle: Prince Sun Wants to Be a Wife
b7ebc129-8729-4121-9f11-c3260d3d97ed.description: Keitarou, dreaming of a soulmate, meets a beautiful brown girl(?) Sun. Apparently, he'd promised to marry Sun when they were young — and it turns out he's a prince of the kingdom of Caglionia! Will they find their soulmate in each other!?

1bfbb8cf-96ea-416e-b211-656a9eb04a57.title: Kyou kara Tsukaeru Isekai Ren'ai Manual
1bfbb8cf-96ea-416e-b211-656a9eb04a57.altTitle: A Love Manual You Can Use from Today
1bfbb8cf-96ea-416e-b211-656a9eb04a57.description:
"I like you. Please go out with me!"

Just as Haruchika Isezaki confesses to his first love, he is suddenly summoned to another world. His summoner, the goddess Clemontine, gives him an unusual mission – to make seven girls, destined to become the mothers of the next generation of heroes, fall in love again. These girls have lost their ability to love due to a curse cast by the Demon King. In other words, Haruchika must make them fall for him!

To return to his world and hear the answer to his confession, Haruchika accepts this mission and sets out to save another world through love. Having mastered the art of romance through psychology and become a Love Master, his journey to fulfill his first love begins now.

e2a150a1-66a7-4e19-adc5-e0d39f5a6603.title: Catastrophic Love
e2a150a1-66a7-4e19-adc5-e0d39f5a6603.description:
Let me tell you about a relationship that totally failed.
I didn’t expect things to turn out like this either.
But honestly, everyone has at least one story like this, right?

35fff7e9-d403-4013-9176-b9cd7432592e.title: A Spoonful Of Your Love
35fff7e9-d403-4013-9176-b9cd7432592e.description:
A secret office romance between the son of the CEO of a huge conglomerate and his newbie secretary slash perpetual liar!   
  
Yeonju gave up her career in order to chase after love, but only found herself left with scars and pain…   
  
After getting a position at a huge company as a secretary, she finds herself face-to-face with her new boss, Jaehyun, who also happens to be a former classmate of Yeonju’s! Jaehyun’s serious good looks and short temper earned him the nickname among his employees, “the S.H.B.”, or the “super, handsome bastard”.   
  
After a series of humiliating situations, Jaehyun admits that he no longer just wants to be friends, and would rather date. Yeonju, who had her mind set on never dating ever again, finds herself interested despite how hard she tries not to fall for him!

a9ce0a44-ae4b-40b9-be3d-76e978cbbdad.title: Hochiya-san wa Amariaru
a9ce0a44-ae4b-40b9-be3d-76e978cbbdad.description: Norito Yonezawa is a low-energy high schooler with little interest in reality. He can't stop thinking about his classmate, Hochiya. She's the complete opposite of him, eating whenever and wherever she wants with no regard to those around her. Despite this, somehow, he just can't look away...

chapters.title: An Account of a Childhood Friend

4c3e41c6-da40-4df1-9978-1c26f7130166.title: DBVS
4c3e41c6-da40-4df1-9978-1c26f7130166.description:
From beyond the boundaries of time and space, special battles are taking place!  
  
Featuring a series of dream match ups, GT Goku vs Goku Black, Super Goku vs Android 21 and Old Broly vs New Broly.

chapters.title: Mysterious Android 21 VS Ultra Instinct Son Goku!!
Fear Of The Devil - GT World!
It's Finally Settled!! The Ultimate Evolution, Super Saiyan 4 God Rushes!!
You Can See Hope When You Are Cornered!! Invocation Of God's Ultimate Technique
Strongest VS Strongest!! Evolution of Saiyan blood!!
It's Finally Settled! The Ultimate Battle That Shakes The Earth!

615123b3-b813-4d7d-8c72-eb5c4146d76e.title: Sugar Meets Girl!
615123b3-b813-4d7d-8c72-eb5c4146d76e.altTitle: しゅがー・みーつ・がーる！
615123b3-b813-4d7d-8c72-eb5c4146d76e.description: Satou Kanna, daughter of a yakuza boss and known for being loyal to her friends and her slightly delinquent appearance. Mochizuki Mito, class president and the school's most envied upon young lady. Just what unexpected secrets did these two girls find out about each other!?

2f46b87a-00dd-4cd3-bf47-68126fb05793.title: Kainushi wa Akuma
2f46b87a-00dd-4cd3-bf47-68126fb05793.altTitle: The Pet Owner Is a Demon
2f46b87a-00dd-4cd3-bf47-68126fb05793.description: Most people love red hair. It's so vibrant and striking. But not our protagonist Nora. Many people in her village hate her because she has red hair because of an old legend in the village. Though some people hate her, she still pulls on. But her not -so-ordinary life might become mysterious and dangerous soon… in more ways than one?!

64c5ace0-0d22-4360-a50b-6660a9604033.title: Batsuichi ga Moteru Nante Kiitemasen
64c5ace0-0d22-4360-a50b-6660a9604033.altTitle: Since When Do Guys Find Divorcees Attractive?
64c5ace0-0d22-4360-a50b-6660a9604033.description: "I'm going to enjoy my second time being single!". Ono Kazuha has divorced her husband at 35 over an affair. She stood tall and announced "I'm officially divorced" to the fashion magazine's editorial department where she works. To add insult to injury, a handsome new hire happened to overhear. She expected it to be awkward, but for some reason it made him attracted to her?

chapters.title: Because I want to marry you someday.
I wish this moment could last forever.
She's still in love with Mitsui-kun?!
It doesn't matter who you are.

e5a829dd-c1d7-4362-ae97-2cc7e48449b1.title: Jongmal eseo Saranamgi
e5a829dd-c1d7-4362-ae97-2cc7e48449b1.description:
A boy was locked in a basement and trained his entire life. His deranged father, the one who confined him, declared, 


“The Apocalypse is coming.” 

Now, armed with the training and survival skills he had honed over years of practice, he must survive the impending apocalypse.

60d15bb8-98b7-47fb-abb8-093769e4ed48.title: Ore wa Benkyou ga Shitai dake Na no ni!
60d15bb8-98b7-47fb-abb8-093769e4ed48.altTitle: All I Want Is to Study!
60d15bb8-98b7-47fb-abb8-093769e4ed48.description: Yotaro, a 3rd year Junior high school student confesses to Megumi, his private tutor who is currently studying at Todai University. Yotaro thought he'd be rejected simply due to the age difference between them but, it turns out that Megumi's only interested in people who can reach Todai's standards. For that reason, Yotaro decides to aim to go to Todai university to seize his chance to be with her! However, unfortunately for Yotaro, he's nowhere near that smart. Despite that, Yotaro decides to dedicate himself to his studies but, unbeknownst to him, a fate that would cast studying out of his mind, awaited him.

chapters.title: Yotaro's Aiming to Enter Todai Uni

567b51cb-ae4c-4a27-af49-92468c5ff4a4.title: Kawaii nante Kiitenai!!
567b51cb-ae4c-4a27-af49-92468c5ff4a4.description:
Madoka is obsessed with shoujo manga—specifically manga that features younger, innocent guys who fall for their Senpai. So she should be thrilled when a gorgeous kohai comes to work at her father’s restaurant…except he’s rude and standoffish, and wants nothing to do with her. But when she protects him from some extra-pushy fans, he finds that maybe he’s found someone letting his walls down for…!

---
Madoka is a high school girl who loves cute younger boys. One day, Shikura arrives as a part-time worker at her parents' diner! Shikura is beautiful and handsome, but he's not super nice?! She thought she would never like him, but the way he sometimes looks is agonizingly cute! How can she not really like him?!
